description: This file implements a Bluetooth broadcast source using Zephyr RTOS, including setup of advertising, stream management, and broadcast control.

methods.name: broadcast_started_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when broadcast stream starts, signals semaphore.

methods.name: broadcast_stopped_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when broadcast stream stops, signals semaphore.

methods.name: broadcast_sent_cb
methods.description: Callback to send mock data over the broadcast stream periodically.

methods.name: setup_extended_adv
methods.description: Sets up extended advertising parameters and creates advertising set.

methods.name: setup_extended_adv_data
methods.description: Configures advertising data including broadcast info and announcement.

methods.name: start_extended_adv
methods.description: Starts extended advertising and periodic advertising.

methods.name: stop_and_delete_extended_adv
methods.description: Stops and deletes extended advertising set.

methods.name: cap_initiator_init
methods.description: Initializes broadcast source stream and registers callbacks.

methods.name: cap_initiator_setup
methods.description: Main setup loop for broadcast, including advertising, stream creation, and periodic restart.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point, initializes Bluetooth and starts broadcast setup.
